statements.summary: Supports reducing building code requirements to lower housing costs.
statements.quote: Let's reduce costly building code requirements that drive up the cost of building homes, including requiring buildings with three stories or more to have two separate stairways, establishing a series of, you know, pre-approved architectural plans for apartments and single family homes that developers could choose.
statements.mechanism: reduce requirement for two stairways in buildings three stories or more; establish pre-approved architectural plans
